page.layout: Top: a list of religious houses in lines, full width, with the page number at top right. Below it, a heading across the full width. Then two columns: left column (AD OCCIDENTEM list, through Vinclham), right column (Torperen list, through Exterhuis). No margin notes, no running head, no catchword, no signature.

main_text.l: Thor Apel in Westerwoldijs, monach.ord. Ctu-
main_text.head: ADDO NOMINA VICORVM, ET LOCORVM, QVOS DVLLARTVS finus haufit.
main_text.l: VVesterreida, in cuius reliquiis nūc castellū militare,
INTER EAM & TIAMMAM amnes, itidem ad occidentem Ex,
REIDERVVOLDE, ubi duo templa, in quorum altero Canonicatus: vicus max,

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Oldecloster" line, the word after "die" (Mame/Name); "(cif." at the end of the "In universum" line; "Vinclham" (could be Vinelham); "Bleyham". The top list is in a larger, irregular type and may be a continuation from the previous page. Shown-through text from the other side has been left out. The "(cif." may be a stray mark or the start of a cut-off word.
